description: This file defines classes and objects related to managing job artifacts in Apache Spark, including session-specific resources like jars, files, and archives, as well as Spark Connect client state management.

classes.name: JobArtifactState
classes.description: Represents the state of a job artifact, including a UUID and optional REPL class directory URI.

classes.name: JobArtifactSet
classes.description: Encapsulates session-specific resources such as jars, files, archives, and optional state, used for managing job artifacts in Spark.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on the artifact set properties.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality between two JobArtifactSet instances.

methods.name: emptyJobArtifactSet
methods.description: A static instance representing an empty artifact set for testing.

methods.name: defaultJobArtifactSet
methods.description: Returns the default artifact set based on the active SparkContext or an empty set.

methods.name: getCurrentJobArtifactState
methods.description: Retrieves the current thread-local job artifact state.

methods.name: withActiveJobArtifactState
methods.description: Sets the job artifact state for the active client within a code block.

methods.name: getActiveOrDefault
methods.description: Returns the active or default job artifact set based on the SparkContext and current client state.
